setting.note: Two principal narrative periods are explicitly identified, not an uninterrupted chronological account of every year between them. The work was published in 1997.

description: Retells Arundhati Roy’s novel through the Ipe family in Kerala, the twins’ childhood in 1969 and reunion in 1993, and Ammu and Velutha’s relationship across caste boundaries. Follows Sophie Mol’s drowning, the false accusation and police violence against Velutha, and the separations that shape the twins’ later lives.
